notes.title: 6-Sided Stories joins Camille & Laura in the new Cozy Narrative Bundle, 20% off!
notes.content:
[p]We're collaborating with our fellow Québécois studio [i]BonjourBorzoi [/i]on the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/59889/Cozy_Narrative/"]Cozy Narrative bundle[/url]: [b]20% off two wholesome, story-driven games[/b].

[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3129110/Camille_and_Laura/"]Camille and Laura[/url] is a point and click about the greatest adventure of all - parenting. It's a genuinely heartwarming story about relationships with friends and family, and learning to express your inner feelings. I highly recommend checking it out!

  [url="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/59889/Cozy_Narrative/" style="button"]Take me to the bundle![/url]  

-Darzington

  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45043862/bbed7895276cb7b9c6f9ddf35ad17bde403321e6.gif"][/img][/p]
